value.rationale: Regularly varying weights are canonical critical Schatten-ideal examples. Their Aluthge iterates have a sharp nontrivial macroscopic singular-value scaling law, an explicit first correction in the canonical power model, and an exact failure of weak-critical ideal convergence despite strong ideal convergence. This is structural information not supplied by qualitative compact-operator singular-value convergence.
